description: This file defines the class ContactFormBase, a base class for handling contact forms in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for generating form HTML, handling form submissions, duplicate checks, and redirection logic specific to contact records.

classes.name: ContactFormBase
classes.description: Base class for handling contact form rendering, validation, saving, and redirection within SuiteCRM, extending PersonFormBase to include contact-specific form logic.

methods.name: getDuplicateQuery
methods.description: Generates an SQL query string to check for duplicate contacts based on first and last name, with optional filtering by record ID.

methods.name: getWideFormBody
methods.description: Creates HTML form markup for extensive contact input fields, including address, phone, email, and custom fields, suitable for wide form layouts.

methods.name: getFormBody
methods.description: Creates HTML markup for a simplified contact form, used in inline editing or quick create forms.

methods.name: getForm
methods.description: Generates the complete HTML form including headers, form body, submit button, and footer for creating or editing a contact.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Processes form submissions to save a contact record, performs duplicate checks, handles inbound emails, and manages redirection after save.

methods.name: handleRedirect
methods.description: Handles redirection logic after saving, directing user to the appropriate module/view based on previous context.

methods.name: getContact
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the Contact bean, used internally to populate or retrieve contact data.
